# shopify_location (List Resource)

Lists the locations of the store. An inactive location can share its name with an active one; the ID tells them apart.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "shopify_location" "all" {
  provider = shopify

  config {
    include_inactive = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_inactive` (Boolean) Also list deactivated locations. Defaults to `false`.
